config.label: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint
config.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com — bring your own (Helius / Quicknode / Triton) for production traffic.

config.label: Ethereum mainnet RPC for ENS resolution
config.description: Ethereum mainnet RPC for ENS resolution. Optional — falls back to ethers' default public providers.

config.label: Optional Helius API key — enables exact supply + DAS data in pump_snapshot
config.description: Optional Helius API key — enables exact supply + DAS data in pump_snapshot.

config.label: NVIDIA NIM key (nvapi-…) — leads the speak tool's TTS provider chain with the free Magpie TTS lane
config.description: NVIDIA NIM key (nvapi-…) — leads the speak tool's TTS provider chain with the free Magpie TTS lane.

config.label: OpenAI TTS — the speak tool's paid backstop when the free NVIDIA lane is unavailable
config.description: OpenAI TTS — the speak tool's paid backstop when the free NVIDIA lane is unavailable.

config.label: Required for the generate_avatar tool (Replicate text/image-to-3D)
config.description: Required for the generate_avatar tool (Replicate text/image-to-3D).

config.label: Replicate version hash pinned for text-to-3D — recommended: latest tencent/hunyuan-3d-3
config.description: Replicate version hash pinned for text-to-3D — recommended: latest tencent/hunyuan-3d-3.1.

config.label: Optional default base58 Solana secret for wallet_send / pump_buy
config.description: Optional default base58 Solana secret for wallet_send / pump_buy. Per-call secret args override this. Treat like cash.

config.label: Optional pump
config.description: Optional pump.fun mint address for $three so tools accept target="three" as shorthand.

config.label: Per-transaction spend cap in SOL for the execution tools (wallet_send, pump_buy, pump_launch, pump_collect_fees)
config.description: Per-transaction spend cap in SOL for the execution tools (wallet_send, pump_buy, pump_launch, pump_collect_fees).

config.label: When on (default), execution tools refuse until re-issued with confirm:true
config.description: When on (default), execution tools refuse until re-issued with confirm:true. Set 0/false to disable the gate.
